patch_description: The current approach combines a demand-weighted direct-link reward with up to five selected two-hop rewards per demand, discounted by transit-node pressure. The proposal uses a more selective, adaptive path set: it scores candidate transit nodes using source/destination demand shares and node pressure, and keeps two or three candidates depending on the demand’s rank. Direct rewards use a softened demand score plus a source/destination-share bonus. Small positive couplings between a direct link and the edges of its selected two-hop alternatives discourage rewarding redundant ways to serve the same demand. The degree penalty remains external; the returned penalty weight is adjusted to 1.15.
